decoded_build_job_log.provenance: Decoded terminal job log returned by GitHub job-log endpoint; retained separately from original UI artifact entries.

publication.qualification: Public HTML and service-worker cache marker were observed with HTTP 200 after deployment. This is source-identity confirmation, not a second public-site UI interaction run.

limits: No local browser pass is credited: local Chromium was blocked before app startup by ProcessSingleton socket EPERM.
Prior failed attempts remain failed and are preserved in history/.
Browser success does not establish physical native hardware, original Windows Phone OS/runtime or 100 percent visual/feature parity.
Native desktop and mobile outcomes are recorded in their own exact-source reports; overlapping test counts are not added together.
